name: SparseLeap Ray-Casting with Occupancy Misses
aliases: Ray-guided volume rendering with empty space skipping
definition: A volume rendering technique that separates meta-data (for empty space skipping) from volume data, using a ray-guided framework where ray segments are processed in a list. It extends standard ray-casting by adding an outer loop over ray segments and handling 'occupancy misses' to delay the determination of whether a brick is empty or non-empty until it is actually needed.
summary: SparseLeap accelerates volume rendering by using a ray-guided framework to skip empty space and delay occupancy checks, reducing traversal steps compared to octree-based methods.
